claim: Literal finite-positive-edge cluster Burkert profiles in X38/SC1 cannot be regular nonnegative isotropic collisionless equilibria confined to r<=rt without a wall, under the continuous binding-potential and cutoff assumptions stated in RESULT.md.
status: proved as written; independent proof gate passed
method: Direct nonnegative velocity integral; finite interior density implies integrability near cutoff, hence rho=o(sqrt(Psi)).
smallest_blocked_implication: An empirically truncated positive-density cluster halo is not thereby a regular no-wall isotropic collisionless equilibrium.
scope: Cluster truncation only; galaxy SPARC functions in these scripts are not hard-truncated at R200
Burkert density is implemented in both X38 and SC1; SC1 isothermal motivation does not alter its density formula
No nonzero boundary-force hypothesis except optional radial-power translation
Analytic boundary theorem is independent of numerical scans and catalog fitting

independent_review.review_scope: Proof, hypotheses, formula coefficient, Burkert derivative, source application and conclusion scope; supporting numeric computation not reviewed by this gate
